assessment: This valuable study advances our understanding of the predictive role of circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) in the prognosis of patients with mTNBC as well as other malignant tumors. The evidence supporting the conclusions is solid, with rigorous analysis of the association between ctDNA (ctDNA-positive or not) with the progression-free survival (PFS) of patients. The work will be of broad interest to clinicians, medical researchers, and scientists working in breast cancer and cancer detection.
